summary.en: Google's Gemini models with strong multimodal capabilities and Google ecosystem integration.
summary.zh: Google 的 Gemini 模型，具备强大的多模态能力和 Google 生态集成。

title.en: Google AI API Key - Official Gemini API Access | Get Model Key
title.zh: Google AI API Key - Gemini API 官方入口 | Get Model Key

description.en: Get official Google AI API key for Gemini models. Access Gemini Pro, Ultra, and Flash with strong multimodal capabilities.
description.zh: 获取 Google AI Gemini 模型的官方 API Key。访问 Gemini Pro、Ultra 和 Flash，具备强大的多模态能力。

en: Google AI (Gemini) delivers multimodal models for text, images, audio, and code, with deep ties to Google Cloud and AI Studio tooling.
Developers typically start in Google AI Studio to prototype prompts, then move the same API key into production SDKs against ai.google.dev endpoints.
Get Model Key only links the official AI Studio API key page. Keys are created and billed on Google’s side—this directory does not sell or proxy keys.
zh: Google AI（Gemini）提供覆盖文本、图像、音频与代码的多模态模型，并与 Google Cloud、AI Studio 工具链深度集成。
开发者通常先在 Google AI Studio 调试提示词，再用同一把 API Key 通过 ai.google.dev 文档中的 SDK/接口接入生产环境。
Get Model Key 仅跳转到官方 AI Studio API Key 页面。密钥在 Google 侧创建与计费，本站不销售、不代发 Key。

en: Open https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey and sign in with a Google account.
Create an API key in AI Studio and restrict it to the projects or APIs you need when available.
Copy the key into a server-side environment variable; never embed it in client-side code.
Follow https://ai.google.dev/docs for base URLs, model IDs, and quota details before shipping.
zh: 打开 https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey ，使用 Google 账号登录。
在 AI Studio 创建 API Key，并在可用选项中按项目或接口做权限限制。
将 Key 写入服务端环境变量，切勿硬编码到前端代码中。
接入前查阅 https://ai.google.dev/docs ，确认 base URL、模型 ID 与配额说明。

question.en: Where do I create a Gemini API key?
question.zh: Gemini API Key 在哪里创建？

answer.en: Use Google AI Studio’s official key page: https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey. Get Model Key only links that page.
answer.zh: 请在 Google AI Studio 官方密钥页创建：https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey。本站只提供该入口链接。

question.en: Is AI Studio the same as Vertex AI?
question.zh: AI Studio 和 Vertex AI 是一回事吗？

answer.en: They both access Google models but differ in console, enterprise controls, and billing. Confirm the product you need in Google’s docs.
answer.zh: 二者都能调用 Google 模型，但控制台、企业管控与计费路径不同。请以 Google 官方文档确认你要使用的产品。

question.en: Does Get Model Key sell Google AI keys?
question.zh: Get Model Key 会售卖 Google AI Key 吗？

answer.en: No. We only list the official key URL. Account, quotas, and payment are handled by Google.
answer.zh: 不会。本站只收录官方 Key 入口；账号、配额与付费均在 Google 完成。
